verdict: Strong efficiency gains hit pause — Meta ads are being restored now.
narrative: Your cost per lead dropped 46% week-over-week and lead volume surged 167%, a strong run driven entirely by Meta. On November 14–15, Meta ad spend went to zero, cutting new leads in half over the final three days of the window — that interruption is being addressed now and is the single priority this week. Google Ads ran $686 in spend over the 28 days with no conversions recorded; conversion tracking is being reviewed, so that channel's true contribution may be under-reported. Once Meta is restored, expect lead volume and cost per lead to return toward last week's improved levels.
